signal_grades.note: Each signal is tested on its own: when it appeared, did SPCX move the way it predicts 5 trading days later (daily) or 7 hours later (hourly)? "Helpful" means right at least 58% of the time with a positive average move, "Misleading" means wrong more often than right, and "Too few" means under 10 examples so far.

today_paragraph: SPCX closed at $159.28, up 7.8% today on 2.4× normal volume, following SpaceX Q3 2026 results yesterday. The daily trend is up: price is above its 20-day average, which is above the 50-day. The overall score is bullish (+51), with one caution on the daily chart: MACD negative. Options look fairly priced, assuming 54% yearly volatility versus 56% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±4% by Friday. Next up: lockup tranche tied to Q3 report (~28% of locked shares) tomorrow. Lockups let insiders sell more shares, which can add selling pressure.
